selection_rule: Nearest-neighbor path of the AF J graph (all J>0), 2-colored with site 0 in color 0. Each color class is sorted by index and cut into consecutive triples. This uses only the sign and support of J, not the ground state.
random_note: Six extra partitions drawn from numpy Generator(20261107) and rejected if they matched contiguous, sublattice, or stride4. Fixed here before any energy evaluation.
logical_basis: index=sum(bit_i*2**i); target H is never permuted
